_comment: What the Chaffee Provides site shows. The Food Web publishes every record statewide and scripts/sync_data.py applies this scope when it syncs; these are choices about the site, not about the facts. county_fips: the counties the site covers. include_sources: a record that one of these sources lists is kept even if the Food Web has no county for it. exclude_producer_types drops every producer of a type (the producer type says what the business is). exclude_only_channels drops a producer whose only ways to sell are listed. exclude_slugs drops a record. hide_pin_slugs keeps a record in the list but off the map. show_unconfirmed_home_pins gives a home-base pin to records whose sales channels are not confirmed. include_outlet_kinds is the shop kinds shown.

exclude_slugs.cottonwood-spirit-ranch: Not applicable for now: mostly a vacation rental that sells beef to guests (Alycen Quattrocchi, Oct 13 2026)
exclude_slugs.mountain-goat-lodge: Lodge and cheesemaking classes on a goat farm: agritourism, not wanted on Chaffee Provides (user, 2026-10-15)

exclude_producer_types.bakery: Bakeries are not part of the Chaffee Provides set (user, 2026-10-15)

exclude_only_channels.wholesale: A grower that sells only wholesale is not somewhere the public can buy (was the Wholesale Grower category)

hide_pin_slugs.everett-ranch-beef: Social media only; listed so people can message them, but not shown on the map (user, 2026-10-15)
